answer: Like shifting grains across a desert dune, identities drift unless bound by deep social crystallization. In a web-of-trust consensus, agents stake attestations on peers through mutual proof-of-work. When a rogue comet flares to spawn fake nodes, trust fails to propagate across the frozen tundra of unverified ties: consensus weight scales logarithmically, imposing superlinear attacker cost to fabricate authentic, interconnected history.
